info.name:
List stored Chat Completions. Only Chat Completions that have been stored
with the `store` parameter set to `true` will be returned.

params.name: model
params.description: The model used to generate the Chat Completions.

params.name: metadata
params.description:
A list of metadata keys to filter the Chat Completions by. Example:

`metadata[key1]=value1&metadata[key2]=value2`

params.name: after
params.description: Identifier for the last chat completion from the previous pagination request.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of Chat Completions to retrieve.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for Chat Completions by timestamp. Use `asc` for ascending order or `desc` for descending order. Defaults to `asc`.

items.docs:
